goal: Prevent memory exhaustion and CPU slowdowns from blocks or transactions with many tiny witness elements
Enforce upfront deserialization bounds to protect nodes against peer DoS
agreement: Unaddressed objection: script verification still allocates 91 MiB for unknown witness versions (fametrano)
Open suggestion: encapsulate vocabulary types before changing internal data layouts (purpleKarrot)
Verified by testing on Windows and checking that allocations drop cleanly (Yudis-bit)
Broad concept approval for mitigating witness memory exhaustion (0xB10C, furszy, instagibbs, rkrux)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it mitigates peer DoS and memory exhaustion during message processing
Transactions exceeding block weight limits or lacking inputs/outputs are dropped before allocating memory

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it eliminates an adversarial memory exhaustion vector in block and transaction deserialization
Worst-case block deserialization memory drops from over 100 MiB to under 4 MiB
Deserialization time for worst-case blocks drops from nearly 300 ms to under 20 ms
